caption: The drawing features a single dress displayed on a headless and handless mannequin form, presented against a plain, lightly shaded background. The dress is a full-length garment in a muted gold or tan color with a floral damask pattern. It has a fitted bodice, long sleeves that end in delicate white lace at the cuffs, and a wide, square neckline also edged with white lace. There is a diagonal decorative element across the bodice, likely a sash or fold of fabric. The skirt is voluminous and reaches the floor, with soft pleats starting at the waist. To the upper right of the main colored illustration, there is a smaller, uncolored line drawing of the same dress showing the back view. This back view drawing reveals seam lines and a fitted back, providing a design reference for the garment’s construction. The overall color palette is limited to gold and neutral tones, while the composition keeps focus on the detailing and structure of the dress.
title: Wedding Dress
